key_idea: From above you only see the top cube of each stack.
steps: On the left, a purple cube sits on a yellow cube.
In the middle, an orange cube sits on a yellow cube.
On the right, there is just one blue cube.
From above, the top cubes hide the yellow ones. So we see purple, orange, blue.

choice_feedback.A: From above the yellow cube on the left is hidden under the purple cube.
choice_feedback.B: This is the wrong way round. Purple is on the left and blue is on the right.
choice_feedback.D: The middle stack has orange on top, not blue.
choice_feedback.E: Purple and orange are swapped. Purple is on the left.
